cards.title: student /ˈstudənt/
sections: Start with /s/ followed by /t/. Do not add a vowel before /s/. The first syllable is stronger: STU-dent.
Listen. Say it. Record a second attempt after checking one sound.
cards.name: Everyday English - A1 - Day 004 - Pronunciation & Listening - 01

articulation.label: student
articulation.alt: student: /s/ → /t/ → /u/ → /d/ → /ə/ → /n/ → /t/. Tongue, lips, contact and airflow positions.
notes: /s/: Make a narrow gap near the ridge; let air flow.
/t/: Tongue tip touches the ridge, then releases.
/u/: High back tongue; round the lips.
/d/: Tip touches the ridge; add voice and release.
/ə/: Relax the tongue in the center.
/n/: Tip at the ridge; air goes through the nose.
/t/: Tongue tip touches the ridge, then releases.
articulation.note: Join the sounds smoothly after practising each position.
